channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Waterspout crosses Sebastian as severe weather brings lightning strikes and fires to St. Lucie County
item.description: Friday's severe weather left a trail of impacts across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County, including a large waterspout over the Indian River Lagoon in Sebastian and multiple lightning-related fires in Port St. Lucie.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 time in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 at Saturday's Diamond League event in London, breaking a 27-year-old world record.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with goals in the 85th minute and stoppage time to beat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals Wednesday.

item.title: Security ramped up for Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey with federal agents and local law enforcement
item.description: A sprawling network of federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies are executing a security plan two years in the making for Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent the use of artificial intelligence for in-game decisions.

item.title: Lionel Messi photographed bathing Lamine Yamal as baby, now they meet in World Cup final
item.description: A 2007 charity photo shoot captured teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in a plastic bathtub. The two will face each other Sunday in the World Cup final.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts qualify for Junior Olympics after top 15 national finish
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying them for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.
